title: Plugin settings registry
summary: Admin → Plugins settings are driven by a shared registry contract. Recruitment gains public board and apply toggles; plugins without settings show an explicit empty state.
changes: Introduce a ModuleSettingsRegistry contract (supports settings, schema, route, permissions, nav label) as the single source of truth for plugin settings.
Adapt APES CIC tickets and cases settings to consume the registry as the reference websites/categories schema.
Add a Recruitment settings page for public board and public apply toggles, gated by admin.modules view/manage.
Show “No configurable settings” on the Plugins index for Consultations and Pet Profiles.
Respect Recruitment board/apply settings on the public roles board and application submit path.
Cover registry discovery, authorization fail-closed behaviour, and public gating with PHPUnit feature tests.
version_rationale: Patch on the v0.35.x line: completes the plugin settings registry and Recruitment settings without changing the Admin shell capability introduced in 0.35.0.
validation: PHPUnit PluginSettingsRegistryTest, ApesCicTicketCaseEnhancementTest, ModuleAdministrationAndNavigationTest, PublicRecruitmentBoardTest, AdminShellNavigationTest, and RecruitmentApplicationWorkflowTest pass.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Shelter and Pet Care tickets/cases instances remain without editable settings (explicit no-settings state).
Recruitment settings only cover public board and apply availability; role/application workflow options are unchanged.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore hardcoded tickets/cases settings discovery and remove Recruitment board/apply toggles.
provenance: Implements issues #253, #255, and #254 via pull request #263; closes epic #247.
